standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that p^* of a flat \mathcal{O}-module is flat over \mathcal{O}_p.

standard_prerequisites.name: Points as morphisms of ringed topoi
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Modules on Sites, section on skyscraper sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the morphism (p, id_{\mathcal{O}_p}) whose pullback functor is the stalk functor.

core_obligations: View the point p as the morphism of ringed topoi (p, id_{\mathcal{O}_p}) : (\Sh(pt), \mathcal{O}_p) \to (\Sh(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O}), with the pullback functor p^* : Mod(\mathcal{O}) \to Mod(\mathcal{O}_p) equal to the stalk functor, as established in the section on skyscraper sheaves (proof lines 7552-7560).
Conclude that \mathcal{F}_p = p^*\mathcal{F} is a flat \mathcal{O}_p-module by lemma-pullback-flat (proof lines 7561-7564).
proof_roadmap: Identify the stalk functor with pullback along the point morphism of ringed topoi.
Apply the preservation of flatness under pullback.
difficulty_reason: The proof is a reduction: it views the point p as the morphism of ringed topoi (p, id_{\mathcal{O}_p}) : (\Sh(pt), \mathcal{O}_p) \to (\Sh(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O}) whose pullback functor equals the stalk functor (the identification established in the section on skyscraper sheaves), so that the stalk \mathcal{F}_p is literally the pullback p^*\mathcal{F}; flatness then follows from the same-chapter lemma that pullback preserves flatness. The identification of stalks as pullback along the point is the substance.
